open_questions.text: Does the College require a pure cloud electronic signature service, or should bidders price the optional on-premises deployment?
Should the scope include providing templates for the twelve most used forms and migrating signed records from the current tool by 2027-02-28?
What are the specific support channels and escalation paths expected for responding to severity-one incidents within one hour at any time of day?
Does the student records system REST API support sandbox testing prior to the 2027-01-11 go-live date?

requirements.statement: The College invites proposals for a cloud electronic signature service.

requirements.statement: The service replaces paper forms for enrollment, financial aid and staff contracts.

approach.text: Bid compliance and project delivery: submit the proposal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages through the College's procurement portal by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC, and ensure the service is live for students by 2027-01-11 for spring enrollment.
approach.basis: The submission channel, PDF format, page limit, deadline, and live date are explicitly specified.

approach.text: Core signature and records: support signing on current desktop and mobile browsers, maintain an audit record of every signature event with signer identity, time, and document version, and store signed documents for ten years.
approach.basis: Browser compatibility, audit requirements, and the ten-year retention period are stated.

approach.text: Integration and workflow: send automated reminders to signers who have not signed within 72 hours, and integrate the service with the College's student records system via its existing REST API.
approach.basis: The 72-hour reminder window and the requirement to use the existing REST API are defined.

approach.text: Service availability: maintain 99.5% service availability each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
approach.basis: The uptime percentage and planned maintenance notice period are explicitly specified.

risks.condition: Proposals must be submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC under REQ-0009.
risks.event: The final bid document exceeds 20 pages or portal congestion delays the upload past 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.
risks.effect: The bid is disqualified immediately without evaluation.
assumptions: The formatting can be condensed into 20 pages without losing required content.
risks.trigger: The draft bid exceeds 18 pages one week before submission.
responses: Enforce a strict 18-page budget for all sections immediately.
Upload the PDF 24 hours before the deadline.
risks.residual_exposure: A technical outage of the procurement portal on the final day.

risks.condition: The service must be live for students by 2027-01-11 for spring enrollment under REQ-0023, leaving only 41 calendar days from the proposal deadline of 2026-12-01.
risks.event: Integration with the student records system REST API or environment setup experiences delays during the winter break.
risks.effect: Students cannot sign documents when spring enrollment opens, breaching the go-live requirement.
assumptions: The College's REST API documentation is complete and accessible immediately upon contract award.
risks.trigger: API integration testing is not completed by 2026-12-20.
responses: Begin mock API integration prior to formal contract award.
Negotiate a staged rollout prioritizing critical enrollment forms first.
risks.residual_exposure: Limited time to resolve edge cases discovered during live student usage.
